hints.title: State Formulation
hints.text: Notice that all values in the grid and the target value are strictly less than 16.

hints.title: Subproblem Definition
hints.text: Let state track the row, column, and cumulative bitwise xor sum.

hints.title: Transitions
hints.text: Propagate paths to adjacent cells down and right, xoring each step's value modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Grid DP with small bounded third dimension tracking cumulative bitwise xor sum.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive path exploration encounters exponentially many overlapping paths.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m * n * 16) table stores path counts per cell and bitwise xor state.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes small value domain to bound xor state space into grid DP.
